Gramps, there's something I want
to talk to you about.

rows.label: kizunainn024_msg0002
rows.name: Why so formal? I'll hear you out.

rows.label: kizunainn024_msg0003
rows.name:
Then I'll tell you when we reach
the Canyon of Husks in
Elpis Spirit Cavern.

rows.label: kizunainn024_msg0004
rows.name: Going all that way just to talk, eh[ML:Dash ]
